# Independent EULUMDAT fixtures

These five fixtures were authored directly from the positional format described
by [DIAL](https://evo.support-de.dial.de/support/solutions/articles/9000074127-beschreibung-des-eulumdat-formats).
They were not generated by the application's serializer or copied from legacy
software. All names, measurements and direct ratios are synthetic test values;
none is suitable for lighting design.

Each full Mc grid has C0, C90, C180 and C270, with gamma 0, 90 and 180 degrees.
The gamma-90 intensities distinguish physical directions. Symmetry 3 stores
C270=40, C0=10, C90=20 in that order: the reconstructed C180 must equal C0=10,
not C90 or C270. Every fixture includes four different luminous-area heights,
so a missing header record cannot pass unnoticed.
